legacy_call_contract.configuration_create_integration: validates a secret-expanded copy, ignores the normalized success payload, and persists the original submitted settings

openapi_behavior.extra_fields: allowed by the pinned legacy SDK model

evaluation_order: reject api_key or client_secret by field presence even when null or empty
reject top-level fields outside the six known non-secret OpenAPI fields
reject array or object values; allow only bounded finite JSON scalars
invoke the unchanged pinned OpenApiConfiguration.model_validate(settings) exactly once

legacy_parity_matrix.evidence_policy: Legacy outcomes are asserted against the pinned SDK model; admitted target cases must match exactly and rejected cases must name an intentional security difference.

schema_evidence.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON produced with keys sorted lexicographically, separators ',' and ':', and ensure_ascii=false; no trailing byte

catalog_evidence.version_policy: The pinned source revision and digests are authoritative; mutable or inconsistent package version strings are not.
catalog_evidence.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON produced with keys sorted lexicographically, separators ',' and ':', and ensure_ascii=false; no trailing byte

target_fixture_binding.authoritative_input_manifest: deterministic binary serialization of elitea.runtime.v1.ExecutionInputBundleV1 in input-bundle.pb
target_fixture_binding.result_input_bundle_digest: the same sha256 over exact input-bundle.pb bytes
target_fixture_binding.fixture_bundle_json: test-only canonical locator cross-checked field-for-field against verified input-bundle.pb; never a production manifest or grant

intentional_target_security_differences: The target returns only valid plus deterministic safe issues; it never returns normalized settings.
The target maps raw Pydantic errors to registered code, JSON pointer, and safe message fields.
Unsupported configuration types produce RuntimeErrorV1 rather than a fake validation result.
The first target fixture profile is credential-free and performs no connection check or network access.
The target rejects model secret fields, unknown legacy extras, and container values before the unchanged pinned SDK validator.
